description: The line plot illustrates the relationship between the o-pop frequency (x-axis) and accuracy (y-axis) for two different conditions: Initial Accuracy and Final Accuracy. The x-axis is labeled "o_pop frequency (x10^4)" and ranges from 1 to 19, with tick labels at every 2 units. The y-axis is labeled "Accuracy" and ranges from 0.0 to 1.0, with tick labels at every 0.2 units. The Initial Accuracy line is represented by a green line with square markers and a solid line style, while the Final Accuracy line is represented by a blue line with diamond markers and a dashed line style. The Initial Accuracy line starts at approximately 0.4 accuracy at an o-pop frequency of 1, peaks at around 0.8 accuracy at an o-pop frequency of 5, and ends at approximately 0.4 accuracy at an o-pop frequency of 19. The Final Accuracy line starts at approximately 0.6 accuracy at an o-pop frequency of 1, peaks at around 0.9 accuracy at an o-pop frequency of 5, and ends at approximately 0.8 accuracy at an o-pop frequency of 19.
